variants.headline: Party leader blunders in election debate
variants.body: The leader of {party}, {leader}, has blundered in an election debate. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: A debate brings a leader's misstep
variants.body: An election debate has included a blunder by {leader}, leader of {party}. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Election argument meets an awkward moment
variants.body: The party leader {leader}, of {party}, has made a debate misstep. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
